IEA Greenhouse Gas R&D Programme (IEA GHG) (2007). CO2 Capture from Medium Scale Combustion Installations. Technical Study, Report Number 2007/7, July 2007. Prepared by Ecofys bv and ECN (Hendriks, C., de Visser, E., Jansen, D., Ruijg, G.J., Carbo, M.), Ecofys report ECS05023. IEA GHG, Cheltenham, UK.

Targeted pass over the 153-page report. Locators are printed page numbers of the Ecofys/ECN main report (PDF page = printed + 14); executive-summary pages are roman (PDF 5-10). Loaded: (1) Ch.6 detailed evaluation of a 50 MWth coal CFB steam boiler (Table 6-3 with CO2 compression to 110 bar, Table 6-4 without): reference boiler, OCM oxy-fuel Case 1 (coal + NG air preheat) and Case 2 (coal only), and Case 3 MEA scrubbing; host rows (fuel, auxiliary power, efficiency, share to capture, emitted and captured CO2 per GJ steam, host capex, O&M, cost per t avoided with Monte Carlo 90% range) split from the capture equipment (MEA plant on capture-unit_amine, CO2 compressor on compressor_co2-dehydration, each with capex and per t-per-yr derived at 7500 h). (2) Ch.5 order-of-magnitude short list: 1.5 MWe gas and diesel engine CHP with membrane-assisted MEA, 5 MWe gas turbine CHP with pre-combustion PSA, 50 MWth coal boiler and 5 MWth NG hot-water boiler with OCM oxy-fuel, 500 kWe SOFC with OCM afterburner, each with and without capture (Tables 5-2 to 5-11), and the avoided-cost range over fuel prices 2-8 EUR/GJ at typical hours (Table 5-12). (3) App. F.1 MEA regeneration energy; compression energy footnote. Not loaded: market/inventory chapters 2-3 (sector totals), Tables 5-13/5-15 (no compression; given in notes or other-values), Table 6-2 equipment sizing, footprints, flowsheet stream tables. Traps: NO price year stated for EUR (2007 used and flagged); Ch.6 boiler specific cost EUR 325,000/MWth is applied to fuel input, not output; Table 5-7 prints CO2 compressor 3.9 M EUR but the text on the same page says 3.8; Case 2 compressor & turbine is 3,663,783 in Table 6-3 but 3,662,335 in Table 6-4; capture ratio in Table 6-3 is of coal CO2 only (Sect. 6.6 gives 78%/88% plant level). Ch.5 heating-value basis not stated (Ch.6 is LHV). Ch.5 capture costs are incremental to the host. Executive summary Table 1 repeats Ch.6 (rounded). Electricity priced at 0.05 EUR/kWh from coal power in all avoided costs. Avoided costs include compression but no transport or storage.
